data.body: Bug-cluster session 3d705fec, 2026-11-18: not worked. Every fix option adds a new top-level CLI flag or subcommand, which the bug-fix rule (no new config key, env var or flag in a fix) excludes without an operator decision, and no option has been chosen on this ticket yet. Still awaiting an operator choice among: (1) add top-level `--version` printing `rebar <version> (<commit>)` from importlib.metadata and rebar._build_info.COMMIT, plus probes in scripts/probe_rebar.py and the release wheel_test job; (2) add a `rebar version` subcommand with the same output and `-o json`; (3) record the absence as intended and close wontfix, dropping `rebar --version` from release check lists.
